scope: Actual128-zone deliveredB1/C13H2 incident spectra and exact350 cadence; incoming normal radial incidence. Physical-yield fits extrapolated to MeV energies and N interpolation are explicit model diagnostics. RES extrapolation uses pulse temperature/flux but is unvalidated in incident energy, isotope decay, damage history and mixed chemistry. AtomicC transport is cosine/flux-Maxwell speed law with absorbing next wall; volatile molecules and dust are separate. No confidence interval assigned to uncalibrated yields.

yield_fit_parameters.N_note: N Q/Eth are midpoint interpolation between C/O and have no fit measurement; isotope mass enters ETF.
